verdict.rationale: This axis applies: INPI runs online filing portals that need user accounts, so how sign-in works is a fair question. The evidence pack never describes the sign-in method, MFA, or whether login avoids biometric, in-person or postal-PIN steps. The online filing pages and the data.inpi.fr probe (keyless access is refused and a token from an account is required) say nothing about the authentication path itself.
